MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY MARCH — TERMLY EXAM #17
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY MARCH
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Conservation of marine and freshwater environments? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Conservation of marine and freshwater environments.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Conservation of marine and freshwater environments.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Conservation of marine and freshwater environments.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conservation of marine and freshwater environments.

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Ecology and Ecosystems? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Ecology and Ecosystems.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Ecology and Ecosystems.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Ecology and Ecosystems.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Ecology and Ecosystems.

3. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. A chemical reaction forming ash
   B. Movement of water only across a membrane
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. Heating until a solid melts

4. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. joule (J)
   B. watt (W)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. newton (N)

5. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Petrol fires have no fuel
   C. Water removes heat too quickly
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

6. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Excretion and osmoregulation in fishes? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Excretion and osmoregulation in fishes.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Excretion and osmoregulation in fishes.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Excretion and osmoregulation in fishes.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Excretion and osmoregulation in fishes.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Ornamental Fish culture? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Ornamental Fish culture.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Ornamental Fish culture.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Ornamental Fish culture.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Ornamental Fish culture.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Buoyancy, locomotion and movement in fishes? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Buoyancy, locomotion and movement in fishes.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Buoyancy, locomotion and movement in fishes.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Buoyancy, locomotion and movement in fishes.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Buoyancy, locomotion and movement in fishes.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Technologies and Innovation in Aquaculture 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Conservatio? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Technologies and Innovation in Aquaculture 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Conservatio.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Technologies and Innovation in Aquaculture 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Conservatio.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Technologies and Innovation in Aquaculture 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Conservatio.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Technologies and Innovation in Aquaculture 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Conservatio.

11. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Glucose and oxygen
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Nitrogen gas only

12. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Overgrazing continuously
   B. Burning crop residue every week
   C. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   D. Removing all vegetation

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Record keeping in aquaculture? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Record keeping in aquaculture.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Record keeping in aquaculture.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Record keeping in aquaculture.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Record keeping in aquaculture.

14. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 100 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 37 °C
   D. 0 °C

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish feeds and feeding? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish feeds and feeding.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish feeds and feeding.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish feeds and feeding.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Fish feeds and feeding.

16. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Milk souring

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Fish Ecology and Ecosystems and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Ornamental Fish culture and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Fish feeds and feeding and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Record keeping in aquaculture and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Technologies and Innovation in Aquaculture 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Conservatio and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Technologies and Innovations in aquaculture and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
